slides.headline: Win a 2-hour e-bike ride for two.
slides.body: Fat tires, Cave Point and a fall afternoon on us. Swipe to enter.

slides.headline: Two 2-hour e-bike rentals.
slides.body: For you and a friend, from our Jacksonport shop. About a $120 value, good through October 2027.

slides.headline: Cave Point, 4 miles out.
slides.body: Tree-covered backroads to the cliffs. Add Whitefish Dunes if you've got the legs. You won't need them.

slides.headline: 1. Comment BIKE below.
slides.body: We'll DM you a link. 2. Finish the 20-second entry form. That's it, you're in.

slides.headline: Tag a friend. Then another.
slides.body: Each separate comment tagging a different friend is one bonus entry, up to five.

slides.headline: Send this to your ride buddy.
Ends Nov 2 at 11:59 pm CT.
slides.body: 18+, U.S. residents. Winner drawn Nov 3 and contacted by DM and email. We'll never ask for payment. Official rules at the link in our entry form. Not affiliated with Instagram.

slides.headline: Good luck. See you on the trail.
slides.body: Can't wait? This fall, book 2 hours and the clock stops after that.
